purpose: Heading + optional short description that opens most sections (the "section-bridge" block). Used standalone as a section and nested inside benefits-stack, features-stack, highlighted-mega, impact-figures, page-tiles, integration-comparison, products-hightlight, payment-method-table and feature-grid.

heading.note: Measured real headings: 2-9 words across the 15 routes (homepage 2-4). Level-c pages 3-8.

description.note: BODY COPY, budget from level-c slot lengths: measured 5-24 words; some bridges have none.

variants.heading+cta-bar: payment-method-table puts a cta-bar in the description slot

motion.reducedMotionFallback: Design rule: render immediately, no fade.

responsive.below800: flex-col, gap-3 (12px step), block-padding 24px sides when a direct child of the page root
responsive.from800: flex-row, gap-8, heading and description each md:w-1/2, block-padding drops to 0

evidence.structure: structure measured against live coda.co (~1px, CLONE_SPEC.md); no copy in this contract
evidence.copy: a-exact on / (2-4 word headings), b on 4 inner pages, c on 9 (short original headings)

measuredFrom.quote: section-bridge flex flex-col md:flex-row w-full gap-3 md:gap-8 my-9 max-w-blogPostVideoW mx-auto
